scope: canonical event envelope, AG-UI mapping, read-only SSE session, A2UI catalog gate

acceptance.criterion: Event scope and delivery ordering are fail-closed
AG-UI mapping uses a fixed event allowlist and removes raw contract/hidden reasoning
SSE session is principal/tenant/run/resource-bound, immutable after authorization, read-only, heartbeat-capable and resumable by cursor/state hash
A2UI is disabled by default and validates an explicit component allowlist when enabled

verification.regression_command: ai-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_p6_event_ui_convergence.py tests/test_p5_api_security.py tests/test_p4_execution_adapters.py tests/test_p3_persistence_events.py tests/test_p2_hitl_state.py tests/test_p1_canonical_model.py tests/test_p0_contract_baseline.py
verification.warning: PytestCacheWarning: .pytest_cache path was not writable on Windows

limitations: The module is a dependency-free transport boundary; it does not expose a production HTTP/SSE server route.
Replay data still comes from the durable store; this phase only classifies cursors and delivery convergence.
A2UI remains disabled by default and no dynamic UI catalog is executed.
WebSocket is intentionally not added; the chosen boundary is HTTP command plus SSE notification/replay.
